verdict.rationale: Bruno ships its own in-product AI (Bruno AI, bring-your-own-key). It offers ghost-text suggestions in script editors, an AI Chat Sidebar for questions, and generation of scripts, tests, and docs that understands the context of the open request or collection. These are suggestions grounded in the user's collection, but the evidence never shows AI analysing response or test-run data to surface insights. missing for 10: documented AI insights or analysis drawn from response, run, or test-result data; independent or hands-on corroboration of Bruno AI quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ghost-text suggestions appear as you type in Pre-Request, Post-Response, and Tests script editors.
The AI Chat Sidebar lets you ask questions and get AI assistance directly from anywhere in your workspace, without needing to open a specific request first.
Bruno AI understands the context of your open request or collection and can generate a complete working App for you.
Open the Tests tab, click the AI icon, and describe what to assert. Bruno generates test code that you can review before accepting.
Open the Docs tab, click the AI icon, and describe the endpoint or workflow. Bruno writes the documentation for you to review and accept.
